xBRIEFInfo.description: F5/F6 - Add six asset metadata columns (one migration)

plan.title: F5/F6 - Add six asset metadata columns (one migration)

narratives.Overview: Add file_size, modified_at, duration, width, height and codec to the assets table in a single migration. Population is handled separately in Stage A and Stage B.
narratives.Problem:
The audit assumed these columns existed. Verified against LibraryStore.swift:114-218 and Asset.swift, the assets table holds only identity and user-authored metadata -- id, relative_path, file_name, status, created_at, tags, external_link, notes, rating, video_name, episode, season_number, episode_number, play_count, last_played_at. None of the six exist.

Consequently F5 and F6 are schema additions plus scanner work plus a backfill, not cache tweaks.
narratives.Action:
One migration adding all six nullable columns, following the precedent set by the rating column at schema v15. Index what sorting needs.

Rationale for one migration rather than two: under the eager-backfill decision, two migrations means two slow first launches. Splitting happens at the POPULATION layer instead, where the risk actually differs.
